patthana15.54:1.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na bhāvanāya pahātabbo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.54:2.1: bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
patthana15.54:3.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na bhāvanāya pahātabbo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve. dassanenapahātabbahetukaduka kusalattike nadassanenapahātabbahetukaduka nakusalattikaṃ
